description: Use this when the user wants a page, site or landing draft for a name and there is nothing to edit yet. Store a draft website in the user's Scopeweb portfolio. Returns a persistent draft_id and a live preview_url. Drafts survive across conversations — use list_drafts in future sessions to resume work. Content is screened on every version; a flagged draft still returns normally here but its preview serves 451.
